job.title: Senior Enterprise Architect (Director) Commerce Technologies (E-commerce, Retail) (m/f/d)

tailoring.headline: Commerce Technologies Architect & Lead Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Headless APIs & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Commerce backend and techno-functional specialist with 5+ years of enterprise experience across SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Extensive background in solution design, data modeling, RESTful OCC APIs, and cross-platform integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Proven track record aligning technical delivery with business requirements, translating complex business processes into scalable commerce solutions, and driving performance optimization.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Enterprise Architect (Director) Commerce Technologies (E-commerce, Retail) (m/f/d)
cover_en.hook: Amer Sports' portfolio of world-class sports and outdoor brands requires resilient, highly scalable commerce technology foundations to power seamless consumer experiences. With over 5 years of experience delivering and integrating enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in commerce architecture, headless APIs, and complex enterprise system integrations.

bullets.label: Commerce Architecture & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend architectures on SAP Commerce Cloud (2105 and 2211), exposing OCC REST Web Services to drive headless commerce architectures and Progressive Web Applications.

bullets.label: Enterprise Systems & Data Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized mission-critical data pipelines connecting SAP Commerce with SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee PIM systems, resolving cross-platform integration bottlenecks across international teams.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Solution Design
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with business stakeholders and product owners to analyse requirements, engineer API migrations, map complex business processes, and translate them into scalable technical specifications.

bullets.label: Platform Performance & Stability
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, optimized FlexibleSearch operations, and executed release cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud CCv2 to maintain transaction performance and high platform reliability.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required) and am currently serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical depth can support Amer Sports' commerce initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: Amer Sports sets the benchmark in athletic and outdoor equipment through iconic brands like Arc'teryx, Salomon, and Wilson. Enabling premium global commerce across direct-to-consumer and retail channels requires robust, headless, and scalable architecture. I am eager to bring my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and integration background to help strengthen Amer Sports' multi-brand commerce platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate about enterprise commerce architecture and scalable integrations, I want to leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience to support Amer Sports' cutting-edge retail platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I saw the Commerce Technologies role at Amer Sports. With 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud, headless OCC APIs, and ERP/PIM integration experience at Rockwell and Shell, I would value the chance to discuss how my background fits your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Enterprise Architect Commerce Technologies – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Enterprise Architect (Director) Commerce Technologies position at Amer Sports.

With over 5 years of enterprise experience developing and integrating SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for global organizations like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer strong expertise in commerce architecture, headless APIs, and enterprise systems integration.

I look forward to discussing how my experience can benefit Amer Sports.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
